skills.name: Subtract Numerators
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions that have the same denominator.

skills.name: Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding a common denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the whole-number parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole-number part to resolve a negative fraction difference during subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify
skills.definition: Simplifying fractions to lowest terms or converting fractions with zero numerators to integer forms.

skills.name: Find Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions with matching denominators.

skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting pure fractions or fractions with same denominators.

skills.name: Mixed Number Partitioning
skills.definition: Separating and independently calculating the differences between the whole-number parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing a unit (1 = d/d) from the whole number part to resolve a negative fraction difference.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing the final fractional answer to lowest terms or eliminating zero-valued fractional parts.

skills.name: Basic fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting fractions with the same denominator.

skills.name: Finding common denominators
skills.definition: Identifying the least common denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole-number subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting whole-number parts when operating with mixed numbers or integers.

skills.name: Borrowing in mixed-number subtraction
skills.definition: Borrowing a unit from the whole-number part and converting it to a fraction to resolve a negative fractional subtraction.

skills.name: Simplifying fractions
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction or the fractional part of a mixed number to its lowest terms.

skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions that already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions with unlike denominators.

skills.name: Separate Whole/Fraction Extraction
skills.definition: Managing mixed numbers or whole numbers by separating and calculating their integer and fractional parts independently.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing from the whole number part when the fractional subtraction yields a negative result.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing fractions to their lowest terms or converting fractions with zero numerators into whole integers.

skills.name: Pure Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting two pure fractional components with same or converted denominators.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Mixed Number and Whole Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting whole number parts and fraction parts independently in problems containing mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Fractional Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing one or more units from the whole number part to complete fractional subtraction when the fractional difference is negative.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing the final fractional result into its simplest terms (lowest terms).
